how_we_use_this: Rules we take into the next card.

rules.rule: Backup safeties do not equal 250 passing yards.
rules.next: Do not build a passing script off a name on the injury report. Need snaps and who actually covers.

rules.rule: A short-week road favorite can look dead even when the name is bigger.
rules.next: Fade or pass the short-week favorite unless rest and travel lean our way.

rules.from: FAMU at MIA / VILL at LOU / NORF at UVA / WKU at UGA / RICE at ND / UCD at SMU
rules.rule: A 50-point FCS or G5 win is not a license to lay 35-plus the next week.
rules.next: Treat a 35-point maintenance number as a bench bet even when it cashes.

rules.rule: Do not lay 20-plus on the road one week after a one-score opener.
rules.next: If the market adds points after a sloppy win, pass. That is a FADE, not a LEAN.

rules.rule: A 28-point home favorite with two tailbacks out is not a maintenance number.
rules.next: FADE means do not post the favorite just to fill the card. Pass or take the dog.

rules.rule: A modest SEC road favorite can trail at half and still cover if the home dog cannot convert third downs.
rules.next: Do not fade a 7-to-10 point SEC number off a sloppy first half. Wait a series.

rules.from: ARIZ at BYU / MIZ at KU
rules.rule: A 6-to-7 point ranked home or road favorite in a real conference game is a live ticket.
rules.next: Do not lump a touchdown number with 28-point paycheck fades.

rules.rule: A plus-money dog still needs the starter to keep it close.
rules.next: Do not bet a depth-arm dog unless the favorite is also throwing a short start. 5-0 after three is dead.

rules.rule: A total that lands on the number is a trap when the board is a round 8.
rules.next: If the total is a whole number and soft, take the half-point or pass.

rules.from: COL at DET / HOU at TB / PIT at CHC / BAL at TOR
rules.rule: A double off the wall is not a homer. Do not force a HR on a name.
rules.next: HR tickets need launch angle, park, or wind. Name alone is not enough.

rules.from: BAL at TOR / LAD at MIA
rules.rule: A player who is not in the lineup is a void, not a lean.
rules.next: Confirm the card at first pitch before the HR or prop is locked.

rules.rule: A 7.5 strikeout over needs a six-inning leash.
rules.next: Four innings of 7 K still loses. Do not post 7.5 unless the starter finishes five.

rules.rule: A road run line needs the starter to finish five.
rules.next: Four innings and four runs is an automatic -1.5 loss. Use the ML if you need the favorite.

rules.from: KC at BOS / NYM at NYY
rules.rule: A -180 to -200 home favorite can still lose by 10.
rules.next: If the juice is that heavy and the lean is weak, pass or take the dog. Props are the real card.

rules.rule: A road favorite that trails early can still cover if the run game takes over after the half.
rules.next: Do not panic on a flat first half when the back has 20-plus carries and the number is single digits.

rules.rule: An extra-inning home win still counts the same on the moneyline.
rules.next: If you are on the home ML in a tight game, stay to the end.
